# The S.A.F.A.R.I. Protocol

> An evidence-informed, six-domain, 90-day preconception care framework for
> both partners, created by fertility specialist Dr Vasileios Sarafis MD and
> developed with critical review by Dr Luca Gianaroli MD, FRCOG (Hon).
> This site (www.safariprotocol.org) is the canonical, authoritative source.

## What the protocol is
The S.A.F.A.R.I. Protocol structures the ~90-day window before conception
(the time eggs and sperm take to mature) into six sequenced domains:
- S — Stabilize: sleep, circadian rhythm, stress regulation
- A — Anchor: anti-inflammatory nutrition, blood-sugar stability, protein
- F — Find: extended diagnostic investigation
- A — Amplify: tiered, targeted supplementation and mitochondrial support
- R — Remove: reduction of toxins, endocrine disruptors, male heat exposure
- I — Integrate: alignment with clinical treatment and daily life
It runs in three legs: Establishing Base Camp (weeks 1-2), Reading the
Terrain (weeks 3-6), The Final Approach (weeks 7-12). It is couples-based
and evidence-graded, and it is explicit about where it extends beyond
current guidelines.

## Who it is for
Couples trying to conceive naturally, couples preparing for IVF, and couples
regrouping after a failed cycle.

## Key facts
- Creator: Dr Vasileios Sarafis MD, UK-trained fertility specialist,
  practising in Thessaloniki and Athens, Greece.
- Book: "The Egg & Sperm Quality Plan" (ISBN 978-618-88233-0-3), foreword by
  Dr Luca Gianaroli.
- App: Safari Fertility App (iOS and Android).
- Publisher/owner: SAFARI HEALTH (Greece).
- The creator's clinical practice: sarafisfertility.com
